about: Each Dashboard Offline UI suite's minutes in its group's job on a runner of median speed, beside another suite (packages/E2E/Scripts/RunUiSuites.js runs a group's suites two at a time): the median, over the App Test runs below where it passed, of the minutes from its '▶ npm run <suite>' to its '✓ <suite> passed in' (the run step's summary gives them to 0.1), its bundle build included. Where no other suite ran beside it for part of that time - a group's last minutes, or a long suite's in a group that held little else - that part counts 1.26 times over, as long as it would have taken beside another. A suite run in parts has one entry per part, '<suite> <i>/<n>', as its groups' <name>_shard say.

1.26 is how much longer a suite takes beside another than alone: the median, over 68 runs of the 37 suites unchanged between them, of a suite's minutes two at a time on the runs below (beside another for at least 90% of them) to its minutes one at a time on 14.3.0's gate runs (43934059780 and 43895788313, the median of the two).
